question.problem:
Find the standard matrix that represents  the  linear  transformation $T:{R}^{3}\to {R}^{4},$ where
$T:[\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]⟶[\begin{aligned}-4x-z+5y \\ 3x+7z-2y \\ -6x+y \\ 8y-3x\end{aligned}].$
question.worked_solution:
We require a $4\times 3$ matrix $T$ such that
    

$$
T\cdot [\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}(-4)x+5y+(-1)z \\ 3x+(-2)y+7z \\ (-6)x+1y+0z \\ (-3)x+8y+0z\end{aligned}].
$$

Notice that
    

$$
[\begin{aligned}-4 & 5 & -1 \\ 3 & -2 & 7 \\ -6 & 1 & 0 \\ -3 & 8 & 0\end{aligned}]\cdot [\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}-4x-z+5y \\ 3x+7z-2y \\ -6x+y \\ 8y-3x\end{aligned}].
$$

Therefore, the matrix which represents the linear transformation $T$ is
    

$$
[\begin{aligned}-4 & 5 & -1 \\ 3 & -2 & 7 \\ -6 & 1 & 0 \\ -3 & 8 & 0\end{aligned}].
$$
